method: For each compounded segment with abs_diff_pp > 0.35 and reason FLOW_TIMING, Opal's linked return is recomputed from the served gold (market_value_eod, external_flow) by round 17's link_alt_flow under START (r = V_t/(V_t-1 + F_t) - 1) and END (r = (V_t - F_t)/V_t-1 - 1); the first in-segment day keeps its served return. Each is compared with the record's bd_gross_return (compounded gross). abs_diff_pp_flow_X = |bd_gross - opal_X| * 100; swing_pp = end - start. within_* count abs_diff <= 0.35. No convention is adopted.
